_comment: Catalog sync (workspace spec 103, D10): what scripts/catalog-sync copies from a local database to production.
system: only the catalog documents, {entitySource: 'system'} unless the entry gives a filter; user documents are never touched.
whole: the whole collection is catalog; production gets exactly the package (missing documents are deleted).
never: user data, not exported. A database given as a string applies the mode to all its collections.
A collection that is not listed makes the export and the import fail: classify every new collection here.
